g.text: 1 | Every run, plus mean and variability
Five saved runs per model and task; each circle is one episode
Output tokens include reasoning; wall-clock includes API requests. Whiskers are sample SD (ddof=1), not confidence intervals.
Task 4 uses the current retained run set; state 0 and seed 0 throughout.
